name: tether
line: Check what an agent says it did against the output it did it with.
evidence: Frozen eval, 120 real claim/output pairs: tether recall 1.0, precision 0.776; a regex matched it (1.0 / 0.95).

name: port
line: Install agent infra on your own Cloudflare account. Preview it, keep it, or tear it down.
evidence: Directory and Sign in with Cloudflare are live. The first installable entry, the agent fleet, is being built.

name: marionette
line: Hard ideas you can poke: autoscaling, PID, interlocks, sync. Each page is a tiny neural network wired by hand, with no ifs.
evidence: Every page replays bit for bit from its inputs alone; the tests and the 3-viewport Playwright gate pass on every page.

name: amber
line: Pause code your agent wrote. A script stops at tool() until a human answers, then resumes mid-loop with no replay.
evidence: Kill fuzz: 210 runs, 1,044 injected crashes, 0 wrong outcomes. In production, replay finished an agent-written script on the wrong result; amber did not.

name: accrete
line: Build each npm CLI your agent calls once in a container, check it against the real tool, then run the saved copy in an isolate with no container boot.
evidence: Sealed receipts on 6 workflows: repeat calls 3 to 18 times faster than npx, same output, 0 container-seconds. Only 4 of 17 candidate tools lift; native binaries and eval stay in the container.
